##: Generated for Tessera's GitHub releases. The versionless asset names in the release are the stable link: /releases/latest/download/Tessera_x64-setup.exe always answers with the newest build, and its .sha256 file is the hash.
description: One search bar for everything your PC can't search — images, screenshots, PDFs, and documents — offline, free, and open source.
notes: The first launch downloads the search models once (about 1.6 GB), checksum-pinned; after that Tessera never touches the network.
Scoop installs the app but not the autostart entry — enable 'Start Tessera when I sign in' in Settings.
